concerns.text: The central claim — clustering descriptors predict segregation energies — is validated only against labels GENERATED by the same EAM potential used in the pipeline, while the only independent check (FR-011 DFT benchmark, MAE ≤ 0.1 eV) is planned to return [DATA_UNAVAILABLE]. With no external ground truth, the study is a surrogate model of one classical potential, not a test of the physical clustering–segregation relationship. The plan must either (a) obtain a verified independent reference (even a small published segregation-energy table for one alloy system), or (b) explicitly reframe all claims in spec/plan/report as 'EAM-potential-internal associational structure', so the headline claim is not overstated.

Bulk structures are reconstructed from formula + spacegroup (OQMD records lack coordinates), then impurities are inserted and energies computed with a single EAM potential 'NIST Fe-Cr class'. Two issues: (1) reconstruction from composition+spacegroup discards the actual OQMD structures, so the 'real data' contributes only a composition list — the plan should state which Wyckoff/prototype assumptions pymatgen makes and that results are insensitive to this choice, or restrict to systems where the prototype is unambiguous; (2) a Fe–Cr-class EAM potential applied across ≥3 alloy systems with arbitrary impurity species is outside the potential's fitted domain — segregation energies for non-Fe–Cr chemistries would be physically meaningless. Specify the alloy systems and confirm the chosen potential is parameterized for each solute–host pair, or restrict the study to systems the potential covers.

concerns.text: The plan does not state whether descriptors are computed on the AS-INSERTED (unrelaxed) or EAM-RELAXED configurations. If descriptors are computed on as-inserted impurity positions, clustering is an artifact of the insertion procedure and the descriptor–energy correlation partly reflects the insertion geometry rather than physical clustering; if computed post-relaxation, descriptors and energies share the relaxation and are not independent measurements. Specify the relaxation protocol and at which stage descriptors are extracted, and justify the choice.

cluster_size is listed as a separate field/plot axis but is not among the three FR-002 descriptors and no computation method is defined anywhere (plan.md, research.md, data-model.md). If cluster_size is derived from the same interface neighbor/RDF information as the predictors (likely, given the edge-case note 'cluster size and density are linearly dependent by construction'), the FR-009 plot and any interpretation of it are partially tautological. Define cluster_size's computation and its relationship to the three predictors explicitly.
